data.one_liner: Flutter widget for programmatic box resizing and dragging with constraints.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that lets you resize and drag boxes in the UI while respecting min/max constraints and custom handle configurations. It wraps the underlying box_transform API for easy Flutter integration.
use_when: You need interactive, resizable UI elements such as image editors, diagram tools, or custom layout builders.
You want customizable drag handles and constraint logic without building the logic from scratch.
avoid_when: The UI only requires static positioning or simple layout without user interaction.
You need a full‑featured animation or physics engine beyond basic resizing.
strengths: Highly configurable constraints and flipping mechanics
weaknesses: Focused only on box transformations, not a general purpose layout system
May add extra overhead for simple use‑cases
